purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's Depot Activity Cancel Group details.
features: Cancel Group Function allows the user to cancel all PR belonging to a group.
If the PR is already transferred to TOPS or the PR Key is linked with an Address, cancelling is not allowed.

events.description: Opens an Alert: "Do you want to Cancel all the Releases under this group, which are not accepted?"
events.triggered_when: User clicks the Menu icon near the desired PR Number and clicks Cancel Group from the single function menu

events.description: Cancels all the PRs under the group which are not accepted. Message: "Port release cancelled successfully"
events.triggered_when: User clicks Yes on the Alert
User clicks No on the Alert
